title: One Intake → Claude Routing → Airtable Core → GoHighLevel & Ops

sections.label: 1 · ONE INTAKE
sections.note: Make, Zapier and form sources all post to the same endpoint and are normalized once. Consolidating three platforms starts by giving them one door, not by rebuilding them.

sections.label: 2 · CLAUDE DECIDES
sections.note: Classify, enrich against Airtable, and return the action against a fixed schema — an agent with tools rather than a chain of if-statements that grows a branch every quarter.

sections.label: 3 · AIRTABLE CORE
sections.note: Every item is written before it is acted on, including the ones that go nowhere. That log is what makes troubleshooting possible instead of archaeological.

sections.label: 4 · ACT
sections.note: Three outcomes, each idempotent — a replayed webhook updates the same record rather than creating a second one.

nodes.label: Any Source Posts In
nodes.notes: Signed and versioned. Make and Zapier scenarios point here, so they can be retired one at a time instead of all at once.
